target: docs/METHODS_COMPARISON.md section B; results/gpufe_verify/VERIFICATION.md; work/board/r0002/pi_updates.md (claims to the PI and the roles)
claim: Several documents claim more than was shown. (1) METHODS_COMPARISON.md section B still recommends an 'own GPU explicit solver (TLED)'. It credits that solver with 'method published + validated for soft tissue on GPU (Miller 2007; Taylor 2008, NiftySim)' and says 'explicit penalty + Coulomb: no convergence failure' and 'frictional stick-slip cannot fail to converge'. The solver actually adopted (DECISIONS 2026-10-26 (1)) is an implicit Newton method with cuDSS and penalty contact. The TLED validation literature does not transfer to it, and it does fail: NaN in 5 of 6 gate-2 directions. The document is the PI's basis for trusting the GPU route, and it has not been corrected. (2) VERIFICATION.md lists gate 1c as PASS without saying it was obtained with the dynamic-relaxation solver, not the production Newton solver (F-0014). It has no row for gate 1d. Gate 2 still reads 'running', while pi_updates.md reports a flexion PASS: the credibility record and the claims to the PI disagree. (3) pi_updates.md: 'Newton non-convergence explained: residual was already at round-off (1e-4 N total)'. The residuals of the gate-2 flexion run are about 2e-4 only in the prestrain phase (t <= 1). In the moment phase the accepted 'converged' states have residual norms 0.09-2.55, which is 3-4 orders larger (t 1.1: 2.55, t 1.2: 0.94, t 1.6: 0.56). That is consistent with FEBio's energy / displacement criteria with rtol 0, but it is not round-off. (4) METHODS_COMPARISON.md gate 2 promises 'facet force vs FEBio'; the gate script does not compare it (F-0014). (5) The M2 / M3 bracket wording ('safe for sure', 'slips for sure') is unproven for curved faces (F-0011).
evidence: docs/METHODS_COMPARISON.md:42 (TLED row, 'no convergence failure', literature), :44-46 ('cannot fail to converge'); docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-26 PI answers (1) 'GPU Newton (cuDSS) + explicit friction return mapping'; results/gpufe_verify/VERIFICATION.md table (no 1d row; gate 2 'running'; no solver named); gpufe/gate1c_friction.py:62; work/board/r0002/pi_updates.md lines 8-15; results/gpufe_verify/gate2/flex_pos_y.json history: res 2.0e-4 at t 0.1-1.0, 2.55 at t 1.1, 0.936 at 1.2, 0.483 at 1.3, 0.560 at 1.6, 0.087 at 1.9, 0.123 at 2.0 (all 'converged': true).
how_to_reproduce: Read the cited lines; extract history[*].res from flex_pos_y.json.

fix_options.option: Rewrite METHODS_COMPARISON.md section B for the solver actually built (implicit Newton + penalty friction), drop the borrowed TLED validation claim and the 'cannot fail to converge' statements, and list the known failures
VERIFICATION.md: one row per gate run with solver class, commit, date, PASS / FAIL, and a link to the report; the verifier, not the integrator, updates the PASS column

Report the residual honestly in pi_updates (value and units per phase), and add a residual-based sanity check (e.g. force residual < 1e-3 of the applied load) on top of FEBio's criteria for the slip-out runs

summary_zh: 有幾份文件的說法超過實際證明的程度。（一）方法比較文件仍然推薦「顯式求解器」，並引用該方法過去的驗證文獻，還寫著「摩擦計算不會發生不收斂」；但實際採用的是隱式牛頓法求解器，那些文獻不能用來支持它，而且它在六個方向中有五個方向數值爆掉。這份文件是計畫主持人判斷 GPU 路線是否可信的依據，卻還沒有更正。（二）驗證紀錄寫著摩擦測試通過，但沒有說明那是用舊求解器跑的；紀錄中也沒有黏著記憶測試，第二關仍寫「執行中」，和給計畫主持人的更新說明不一致。（三）更新說明寫「牛頓法的殘差已經到了數值極限（萬分之一牛頓）」，但在施加力矩的階段，被判定為收斂的殘差是 0.09 到 2.55，大了一千到一萬倍。（四）方法文件承諾第二關會比較小面關節力，實際上並沒有比較。（五）摩擦指標「一定安全／一定滑動」的說法，對彎曲接觸面並未被證明（見 F-0011）。
